relationships.subject: erenumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Erenumab, a monoclonal antibody against the calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) receptor, has proven efficacy in migraine.

key_findings: Erenumab 140 mg did not reduce pain versus placebo in trigeminal neuralgia (35% vs 45% responders).
CGRP probably does not have an important role in paroxysmal pain.
